mapper.select: SELECT st.*, COALESCE(stv_site.id, stv_hospital.id, stv_institution.id, stv_tenant.id) as valueId, COALESCE(stv_site.template_type_name, stv_hospital.template_type_name, stv_institution.template_type_name, stv_tenant.template_type_name) as templateTypeNameValue, COALESCE(stv_site.storage_id, stv_hospital.storage_id, stv_institution.storage_id, stv_tenant.storage_id) as valueStorageId, COALESCE(stv_site.file_name, stv_hospital.file_name, stv_institution.file_name, stv_tenant.file_name) as fileNameValue, COALESCE(stv_site.site_uid, stv_hospital.site_uid, stv_institution.site_uid, stv_tenant.site_uid) as siteUid FROM system_template st LEFT JOIN system_template_value stv_site ON st.template_type = stv_site.template_type AND stv_site.site_uid = #{siteUid} LEFT JOIN system_template_value stv_hospital ON st.template_type = stv_hospital.template_type AND stv_hospital.site_uid = #{hospitalUid} AND stv_site.id IS NULL LEFT JOIN system_template_value stv_institution ON st.template_type = stv_institution.template_type AND stv_institution.site_uid = #{institutionUid} AND stv_site.id IS NULL AND stv_hospital.id IS NULL LEFT JOIN system_template_value stv_tenant ON st.template_type = stv_tenant.template_type AND stv_tenant.site_uid = #{tenantUid} AND stv_site.id IS NULL AND stv_hospital.id IS NULL AND stv_institution.id IS NULL where st.template_type=#{templateType}
